title: Word Frequency Counter
h1: Word Frequency Counter — Find Most Common Words
seoTitle: Word Frequency Counter — Free Online Text Analyzer
description: Count how often each word appears in any text. See the most frequent words with counts. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Paste any text to see a ranked list of the most common words and their frequencies. Stop words can be ignored. Nothing is uploaded.
blurb: Count word frequencies in any text and see the most common words.
howItWorks: Paste or type text into the box.
Optionally ignore common English stop words.
Press Count words to see a ranked list of words and how many times each appears.
examples: Find the most repeated words in an essay or blog post.
Analyze a speech transcript for key terms.

faq.q: Are stop words ignored by default?
faq.a: Yes. Common words such as the, a, and, of are skipped when the checkbox is enabled so the list focuses on meaningful terms.
No. All counting happens locally in your browser.
